name: Skofnung
desc: The sword that will not be drawn in daylight. Heals as it cuts.

name: Járngreipr
desc: Thor's iron gloves. Every blow arcs lightning; airborne foes suffer most.

name: Gleipnir
desc: The fetter that held the wolf: woven of impossible things.

name: Draupnir
desc: The ring that drips eight more every ninth night.

name: Gjallarhorn's Eye
desc: A sight that sees grass grow; it finds the seam in any armour.

name: Svalinn
desc: The shield that stands before the sun.
